suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When prescribing symbol removals from __init__.py files, workers should first verify which symbols are actually present before listing them in the feature description. This avoids mismatches between prescribed removals and actual code state.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature delete-dead-schemas-final-cleanup listed TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, TaskResponse, and CamelCaseModel as symbols to remove from api/schemas/__init__.py, but only SessionCreate, SessionUpdate, SessionResponse were actually imported there.
